'''1137-4265''' was a sector on [[Teth/Legends|Teth]]. During the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] briefly occupied this area.

==Behind the scenes==
1137 is a reference to the [[1138 (easter egg)|1138]] [[easter egg]].
